We need number of CH3 groups in the compound. But we have no description of compound. Possibly need to get NMR spectra to infer? But we don't know the molecule. Maybe the sample is implicit? Could be the compound at hand, which we can query via NMR tools. The carbon_nmr_spectra returns spectra string; we could infer number of methyl carbons (CH3) from peaks around 10-30 ppm. But easier: use proton NMR to count methyl signals (singlet, doublet, etc). However we need integer.

We need to get the spectra. Use proton_nmr_spectra tool.
